Serperior

Grass

Unova · Generation 5

Serperior is a Grass-type Regal Pokémon first found in Unova (Generation 5). It stands 3.3 m tall and weighs 63 kg. It evolves from Servine. Its highest base stat is Speed (113), with a base stat total of 528.
